name: Overton Park Plaza
demographics: Overton Park Plaza serves a diverse Fort Worth market at the intersection of I-20, Loop 820, and Highway 183, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the southwest Fort Worth area. The trade area includes established residential neighborhoods with a mix of homeowners and renters, typically ranging from young families to mature adults aged 25-65. The strategic highway location draws both local shoppers seeking convenience and commuters passing through this major transportation hub, with visitors prioritizing accessibility and everyday shopping needs.
description: Overton Park Plaza is a strategically positioned shopping center located at the vital intersection of I-20, Loop 820, and Highway 183 in Fort Worth, Texas. This prime location at SW Loop 820 and S Hulen Street makes it one of the most accessible retail destinations in southwest Fort Worth, serving as a convenient stop for both local residents and commuters traveling through this major transportation corridor. Managed by FRP Ltd., a professional real estate investment and management company specializing in retail, healthcare, residential, and industrial properties, Overton Park Plaza benefits from experienced oversight and strategic tenant curation. The center offers a diverse mix of retail and service tenants designed to meet the everyday needs of the surrounding community, with ample leasing opportunities available for businesses seeking high-visibility locations with excellent highway access. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 4,000 Google reviews, Overton Park Plaza has established itself as a trusted and well-regarded shopping destination in the Fort Worth market.
summary: Overton Park Plaza is a well-positioned community shopping center at the intersection of I-20, Loop 820, and Highway 183 in Fort Worth, offering convenient access to retail and services for southwest Fort Worth residents and commuters. Managed by FRP Ltd., the center maintains a strong 4.3-star rating and serves as a reliable everyday shopping destination.
